leads.name: Bothra Classes
findings: Site loads fast and is mobile-ready, but has no WhatsApp contact link (checked in page code)
No visible enrolment or test-registration flow detected on the home page
Footer copyright shows 2024, so the site looks not recently maintained
leads.offer: Online registration + WhatsApp enquiry funnel for the scholarship test and demo classes
leads.upsell: Result and scholarship dashboard, then a ₹4–6k/month upkeep plan
leads.pitch: Show a 1-screen demo of 'Register for BEST in 60 seconds' with an auto WhatsApp confirmation.
leads.msg: Namaste! I'm a web developer based in Ahmedabad. I looked at bothraclasses.com and noticed there's no WhatsApp or online registration option for the BEST scholarship test, so parents have to call. I've sketched a small registration + WhatsApp flow that could capture those enquiries automatically. Can I send you a 1-page preview? No obligation.

leads.name: Muskaan Laser Dental Clinic & Implant Centre
findings: Only third-party directory (WhatClinic) pages found in search; no official website surfaced
Directory page lists implants, braces, veneers and whitening: services people research online
Verify on Google Maps first whether a site or Google Business Profile exists
leads.offer: Clinic website with treatment pages, before/after gallery and online appointment request
leads.upsell: WhatsApp appointment reminders and Google Business optimisation, ₹3–5k/month
leads.pitch: Prepare a sample homepage for the clinic with its real treatments.
leads.msg: Namaste Doctor! I'm a local web developer. I couldn't find an official website for Muskaan Laser Dental Clinic, only directory listings, so patients searching for implants in Satellite may never reach you directly. I can build a simple site with online appointment requests. Happy to show a sample homepage first. May I send it?

leads.name: Deekay Fluorine Industries
findings: IndiaMART verification page shows a Naroda GIDC Phase 2 address and import-export code
Web search found no official website for the company
Overseas buyers usually check a company website before trusting a supplier
leads.offer: B2B company website: product catalogue, certifications, export enquiry form and downloadable PDF brochure
leads.pitch: Lead with credibility: 'foreign buyers can't verify you without a site'.
leads.msg: Hello Sir, I'm a web developer in Ahmedabad. I came across Deekay Fluorine Industries on IndiaMART and couldn't find your own website. Export buyers often look for one before sending enquiries. I can build a clean catalogue site with an enquiry form. Can I share a sample made for a Naroda manufacturer?

leads.name: Sonika Engineers
findings: Site is HTTPS and mobile-ready, with a WhatsApp link and enquiry form
Footer copyright reads 2021, so content and design look dated
Title says 'Manufacturers in India': generic, nothing about Ahmedabad or key products
leads.offer: Redesign and SEO refresh: product pages by fan type, case studies, faster page, Gujarat/Ahmedabad keywords
leads.pitch: Quick before/after of their homepage plus 3 SEO fixes.
leads.msg: Hello Sir, I'm a web developer in Ahmedabad. Your site sonikaengineers.com works well on mobile, but the content looks dated and doesn't target buyers searching for specific fan types. I've listed 3 quick fixes that could bring more enquiries. Can I send them over? No charge.

leads.name: Vision Interio
findings: Only an IndiaMART profile found; no standalone website
Interior design is chosen visually, so a portfolio site matters
Verify on Google Maps for an Instagram or Google profile before pitching
leads.offer: Portfolio website with project gallery, WhatsApp enquiry and Google Maps location
leads.upsell: Instagram-to-site lead capture and Google Business setup
leads.pitch: Build a quick gallery mock using photos they already have public.
leads.msg: Namaste! I'm a web developer in Ahmedabad. Vision Interio has 20+ years of work but I could only find an IndiaMART page, so clients can't see your portfolio properly. I can build a simple gallery website with WhatsApp enquiry. Want me to send a sample layout?
